summary.text: Ben Wieman is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 17B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Bobbie Harder.
An audio-video applications engineer who grew up on a dairy farm near Arlington, he lists agriculture and public school funding among his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Ben Wieman graduated from Sibley East High School, attended Minnesota State University, Mankato, and earned an associate degree from Ridgewater College in Hutchinson in 2012.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on a dairy farm west of Arlington, took part in 4-H and FFA, and went to college for music performance and audio engineering.
He said his career in the professional audio and video industry took him to the Twin Cities, Oregon, Tennessee and Australia before he returned to the family farm during COVID.
Wieman said he now works remotely as an Audio Video Applications Engineer for Biamp Systems and lives north of Arlington.

He said he would stand up for small and family farms, and that every child in rural Minnesota deserves a high-quality education with schools funded so districts do not rely increasingly on property taxes.
